title: The closet door wasn't on the floor plan
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American home at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: There's a second door in my closet. It's not on the floor plan.

scenes.narration: My closet has a second door.

shots.prompt: narrow closet door in a bedroom, a second door visible behind the hanging clothes, thin light under it, no person visible

overlays.text: That unit has no second door.

scenes.narration: I moved in Monday. Small apartment. One closet. Behind my coats, I found a door. Plain. Painted over. Warm to the touch. Like something had just leaned on it from the other side.

shots.prompt: dark apartment bedroom closet with coats pushed aside, a painted door behind them

scenes.narration: I checked the floor plan. No door. I texted my landlord. He said, that closet is one foot deep. Mine is six. I measured it twice. The numbers made no sense.

shots.prompt: apartment lease floor plan paper on a table in dim lamp light, blurred lines, no text legible

scenes.narration: That night I heard it. Soft knocking. From inside the door. Three taps. Then a pause. Then three more. Like it was waiting politely. Like it knew I was awake.

shots.prompt: closet door in a dark bedroom at night, narrow light beneath it

scenes.narration: By morning, the door was open. A few inches. My coats were pushed aside. And my slippers were gone from beside the bed. I never opened it. I live alone.

shots.prompt: bedroom floor at dawn, an empty spot beside a bed, closet slightly open, dark gap

scenes.narration: Tonight I set up my phone to film the closet. At 3:03 a.m. the door opened wide. Nobody came out. Instead, my phone saw me. Sitting up in bed. Walking toward it. Asleep. Eyes open. Smiling at the dark.

shots.prompt: night vision style dark bedroom viewed from a closet, bed in the distance, blurred figure rising, no face

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you wake me up, or follow me inside?

shots.prompt: narrow closet door in a bedroom, a second door visible behind the hanging clothes, thin light under it, no person visible
